source.request: Is industrial decarbonisation associated with job creation or job displacement?

question: Are improvements in environmental performance associated with more jobs, higher pay, or a different workforce?
rationale: Describe within-factory associations while separating shared numerators, output expansion and workforce composition from technological or causal claims.
scope: Full exact Word row, interpreted through repository minimum checks and current owner full-plan ning/full-row acceptance gates. All analysis below is planned, not executed.
unit_of_analysis: Verified establishment-year and true adjacent-year change pairs; workforce components reconciled to annual totals.

target_estimands.name: Primary requested target
target_estimands.formula: Delta ln(L_it) = lambda_t + beta Delta ln(V_it/E_it) + u_it; FE: ln(L_it)=alpha_i+lambda_t+beta ln(V_it/E_it)+u_it

symbols.i: a verified establishment, never a row-number or artificial linkage
symbols.V: value added deflated with a certified appropriate price index; any single-output-deflator approximation is named
symbols.Y: gross output deflated with its certified output-price index
symbols.E: scope-defined verified physical energy in GJ; incomplete observed subtotals are separately named
symbols.C: scope-defined verified CO2 in metric tonnes; not automatically all greenhouse gases
symbols.L: workers under an annually verified employment definition
symbols.X: predetermined measured covariates declared for the particular design
symbols.g: verified treatment-entry cohort in calendar years
symbols.S: a verified trade, ownership, industry, or survival state; unknown is retained as unknown
symbols.Delta: difference across actual adjacent calendar years
symbols.beta: noncausal within-factory or change association, depending on specified model
symbols.alpha_i: plant effect in the levels model

target_estimands.interpretation: The coefficient describes a change or within-factory association. Carbon productivity replaces energy productivity in a separate model; underlying V, E, C, Y, L components are always reported.
target_estimands.limits: Jobs, output and energy can respond simultaneously to demand. A common value-added numerator can mechanically relate productivity ratios. Wage per worker mixes pay and composition; absent wages cannot be zeros. A causal policy branch requires a new credible design.
